Group rides in Pennsylvania

15 recurring group rides around Pennsylvania: 9 road, 5 social, 3 gravel. 11 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with CAT Women's Ride in Bethlehem — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Tuesday Training Ride (Lancaster Bicycle Club) runs a (18–20 mph) and A+ (20–22 mph) groups.
